messages.subject: filter monomorphs excluding NA's silicoDArT
parts:
Hi all

I am new to using silicoDArT data and trying to apply some quality filters to my data set. I've noticed that many of my silicoDArT markers are monomorphic except for individuals scored as "-" (missing data) and that these loci are not detected/removed using the gl.report.monomorphs/gl.filter.monomorphs functions. I should be able to write some code to do this manually but wondered if there is an option in dartR to perform calculations to identify monomorphic loci excluding NA values before I do so?

Thanks in advance
Kym

messages.author: c4656630f2b5b33d
messages.subject: Re: filter monomorphs excluding NA's silicoDArT
parts:
For what it's worth the following step needs to be removed from the gl.report.monomorphs function when applied to silicoDArT data:

mono_tmp <- gl.alf(x)
    loc.list <- rownames(mono_tmp[which(mono_tmp$alf1==1 |
                                          mono_tmp$alf1 == 0),])
    loc.list_NA <- rownames(mono_tmp[which(is.na(mono_tmp$alf1)),])

gl.alf is assuming co-dominant data so all "1" alleles are counted as heterozygotes (alf1 = 0.5, alf2 = 0.5) and consequently no loci meet the condition alf1==1 or alf1==0. Removing this step allows the first part of the function to remove monomorphic loci correctly accounting for missing data.

Cheers
Kym
